name: Global chatting
description:
Allows chat messages to be sent that can be seen by all the players on the same server.

**How To Use**
When you use this item to send a server wide message, click the ok button after entering the chat messsage in the box.

**Restriction**
None

Redeem one package to a character. Its NFT is permanently locked and cannot be resold or withdrawn. The delivered items follow their native game rules.
